The SMC chopped fibers described earlier were in the 0.5” to 1” length coming off the cutting module. Owens Corning glass fiber roving was used to produce chopped glass SMC. The Arotran (Ineos) vinyl ester resin (Derakane 780 with Arotran 241 hardener) described earlier was used. The hybrid SMC composition was 10% glass fiber and 10% rCF for these runs. Figure 59 illustrates the development approach. The rCF was fed through the mechanism described earlier where the rCF mats were conveyed on the conveying belt. The glass fiber rovings were chopped in the cutting module and fell onto the rCF by gravity, i.e., not directly on the conveyor but on the rCF which moved at the belt speed.
